title: "Ultra"
subtitle: "Every trail in Pacific Spirit, in one run from the Park Centre"
format:
  html:
    include-in-header:
      text: |
        <link rel="stylesheet" href="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/maplibre-gl@5.24.0/dist/maplibre-gl.css">
---

One route that runs every trail in the park at least once, starting and
finishing at the **Park Centre** (the ranger station on Cleveland Trail at
W 16th Ave). It's also the aid station: park for free along W 16th Ave,
right in the middle of the park, and there are toilets and drinking water.
The route comes back past it along the way.

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
ultra = FileAttachment("ultra.json").json()
labels = FileAttachment("labels.geojson").json()
stats = ultra.stats

function kmRange([a, b]) {
  const [from, to] = [Math.round(a), Math.round(b)];
  return from === to ? `km ${from}` : `km ${from}–${to}`;
}

function onTheWay(kind) {
  return stats.on_the_way.filter(([, , kinds]) => kinds.includes(kind)).map(kmRange);
}
water = onTheWay("water")

html`<div class="route-card">
  <p class="route-stats">
    <strong>${stats.km} km</strong> ·
    <strong>↑ ${stats.gain_m} m ↓ ${stats.loss_m} m</strong> ·
    every trail (${stats.trail_km} of ${stats.park_trail_km} km of park trail) ·
    ${stats.repeat_km} km run twice · ${stats.street_pct}% street
  </p>
  <p class="route-stats">
    <strong>Aid station</strong> (Park Centre): start,
    ${stats.aid.slice(1, -1).map(kmRange).join(", ")}, finish ·
    <strong>Toilets on the way</strong>: ${onTheWay("toilets").join(", ")} ·
    <strong>Water</strong>: the aid station${water.length ? `, and near ${water.join(", ")}` : " only"}
  </p>
  <p class="route-id">Short dead-end offshoots are optional: without them it's
    ${stats.km_without_offshoots} km (they add ${stats.offshoot_km} km, out and back).</p>
</div>`
```

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
```
```{ojs}
//| output: false
// Toilets, water, or both: drawn once, for the map and the legend.
AMENITY = ({toilets: "Toilets", water: "Water", both: "Toilets and water"})

ICONS = {
  // The same marks as the trail map: a yellow "WC" dot, a magenta "W" dot.
  const R = 2, D = 22; // pixel ratio; one dot, in CSS px
  function dot(ctx, cx, color, letters) {
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(cx, D / 2, D / 2 - 1.5, 0, 2 * Math.PI);
    ctx.fillStyle = color;
    ctx.fill();
    ctx.lineWidth = 2;
    ctx.strokeStyle = "#fcfcfb";
    ctx.stroke();
    ctx.fillStyle = "#0b0b0b";
    ctx.font = "700 9px system-ui, -apple-system, sans-serif";
    ctx.textAlign = "center";
    ctx.textBaseline = "middle";
    ctx.fillText(letters, cx, D / 2 + 0.5);
  }
  function icon(...dots) { // dots side by side
    const width = D + (dots.length - 1) * 16;
    const canvas = Object.assign(document.createElement("canvas"), {width: width * R, height: D * R});
    canvas.style.width = `${width}px`;
    const ctx = canvas.getContext("2d");
    ctx.scale(R, R);
    dots.forEach(([color, letters], i) => dot(ctx, D / 2 + i * 16, color, letters));
    return canvas;
  }
  const toilets = ["#eda100", "WC"], water = ["#e87ba4", "W"];
  return {toilets: icon(toilets), water: icon(water), both: icon(toilets, water)};
}
```

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
//| output: false
maplibregl = require("maplibre-gl@5.24.0/dist/maplibre-gl.js")
START = [-123.22248, 49.25918] // Park Centre
EMPTY = ({type: "FeatureCollection", features: []})

map = {
  const m = new maplibregl.Map({
    container: mapDiv,
    style: "https://tiles.openfreemap.org/styles/positron",
    center: START,
    zoom: 12.5,
    attributionControl: {customAttribution: "Trails © OpenStreetMap contributors (ODbL)"}
  });
  m.addControl(new maplibregl.NavigationControl(), "top-right");
  m.addControl(new maplibregl.FullscreenControl(), "top-right");
  await new Promise((resolve) => m.on("load", resolve));
  m.addSource("labels", {type: "geojson", data: labels});
  m.addSource("segments", {type: "geojson", data: ultra.segments});
  m.addSource("points", {type: "geojson", data: ultra.points});
  m.addSource("hover", {type: "geojson", data: EMPTY});
  const round = {"line-join": "round", "line-cap": "round"};
  const width = ["interpolate", ["linear"], ["zoom"], 12, 2.5, 16, 5];
  const kind = (k) => ["==", ["get", "class"], k];
  m.addLayer({id: "trails", type: "line", source: "labels", layout: round,
              filter: ["==", ["get", "kind"], "trail"],
              paint: {"line-color": "#6b8f71", "line-opacity": 0.6, "line-width": 1}});
  // Stretches run twice are drawn beside the first pass, so both show.
  m.addLayer({id: "repeat", type: "line", source: "segments", layout: round, filter: kind("repeat"),
              paint: {"line-color": "#eb6834", "line-width": width, "line-offset": 3}});
  m.addLayer({id: "first", type: "line", source: "segments", layout: round, filter: kind("first"),
              paint: {"line-color": "#2a78d6", "line-width": width}});
  m.addLayer({id: "optional", type: "line", source: "segments", filter: kind("optional"),
              paint: {"line-color": "#4a3aa7", "line-width": width, "line-dasharray": [1, 1]}});
  m.addLayer({id: "arrows", type: "symbol", source: "segments",
              layout: {"symbol-placement": "line", "symbol-spacing": 120, "text-field": "›",
                       "text-font": ["Noto Sans Bold"], "text-size": 18,
                       "text-keep-upright": false, "text-allow-overlap": true,
                       "text-ignore-placement": true},
              paint: {"text-color": "#0b0b0b"}});
  const halo = {"text-halo-color": "#fcfcfb", "text-halo-width": 1.5};
  const along = (size, font) => ({"symbol-placement": "line", "text-field": ["get", "name"],
    "text-font": [font], "text-size": size, "text-max-angle": 45, "symbol-spacing": 250});
  m.addLayer({id: "street-labels", type: "symbol", source: "labels", minzoom: 13,
              filter: ["==", ["get", "kind"], "street"], layout: along(10.5, "Noto Sans Regular"),
              paint: {"text-color": "#52514e", ...halo}});
  m.addLayer({id: "trail-labels", type: "symbol", source: "labels", minzoom: 13,
              filter: ["==", ["get", "kind"], "trail"], layout: along(11, "Noto Sans Italic"),
              paint: {"text-color": "#3d6b47", ...halo}});
  // km markers and toilets
  m.addLayer({id: "km", type: "circle", source: "points", filter: ["==", ["get", "kind"], "km"],
              paint: {"circle-radius": 11, "circle-color": "#fcfcfb",
                      "circle-stroke-color": "#0b0b0b", "circle-stroke-width": 2}});
  m.addLayer({id: "km-labels", type: "symbol", source: "points", filter: ["==", ["get", "kind"], "km"],
              layout: {"text-field": ["get", "label"], "text-font": ["Noto Sans Bold"],
                       "text-size": 11, "text-allow-overlap": true},
              paint: {"text-color": "#0b0b0b"}});
  for (const [kind, canvas] of Object.entries(ICONS)) { // the style has its own "toilets"
    const {width, height} = canvas;
    m.addImage(`amenity-${kind}`, canvas.getContext("2d").getImageData(0, 0, width, height), {pixelRatio: 2});
  }
  m.addLayer({id: "amenities", type: "symbol", source: "points",
              filter: ["in", ["get", "kind"], ["literal", Object.keys(AMENITY)]],
              layout: {"icon-image": ["concat", "amenity-", ["get", "kind"]], "icon-allow-overlap": true}});
  m.on("click", "amenities", (e) => {
    const f = e.features[0];
    new maplibregl.Popup()
      .setLngLat(f.geometry.coordinates)
      .setText(`${AMENITY[f.properties.kind]}: ${f.properties.label}`)
      .addTo(m);
  });
  m.on("mouseenter", "amenities", () => (m.getCanvas().style.cursor = "pointer"));
  m.on("mouseleave", "amenities", () => (m.getCanvas().style.cursor = ""));
  m.addLayer({id: "hover", type: "circle", source: "hover",
              paint: {"circle-radius": 7, "circle-color": "#eb6834",
                      "circle-stroke-color": "#fcfcfb", "circle-stroke-width": 2}});
  new maplibregl.Marker({color: "#0b0b0b"})
    .setLngLat(START)
    .setPopup(new maplibregl.Popup().setText("Start, finish and aid station: Park Centre (toilets and water)"))
    .addTo(m);
  const bounds = new maplibregl.LngLatBounds();
  ultra.full.forEach((c) => bounds.extend(c));
  m.fitBounds(bounds, {padding: 30, duration: 0});
  invalidation.then(() => m.remove());
  return m;
}
```

```{ojs}
profile = ultra.profile.map(([km, m, lon, lat]) => ({km, m, lon, lat}))

viewof here = {
  const low = Math.floor((d3.min(profile, (d) => d.m) - 5) / 10) * 10;
  return Plot.plot({
    width,
    height: 180,
    marginLeft: 44,
    style: {fontSize: "12px"},
    x: {label: "km →", domain: [0, stats.km]},
    y: {label: "↑ elevation (m)", domain: [low, d3.max(profile, (d) => d.m) + 5], grid: true},
    marks: [
      Plot.areaY(profile, {x: "km", y1: low, y2: "m", fill: "#2a78d6", fillOpacity: 0.12}),
      Plot.lineY(profile, {x: "km", y: "m", stroke: "#2a78d6", strokeWidth: 1.5}),
      // Aid station passes
      Plot.ruleX(stats.aid.map(([a]) => a), {stroke: "#0b0b0b", strokeDasharray: "3,3"}),
      Plot.ruleX(profile, Plot.pointerX({x: "km", stroke: "#52514e"})),
      Plot.dot(profile, Plot.pointerX({x: "km", y: "m", fill: "#eb6834", r: 4})),
      Plot.tip(profile, Plot.pointerX({x: "km", y: "m",
        title: (d) => `${d.km.toFixed(1)} km · ${Math.round(d.m)} m`}))
    ]
  });
}
```

Dashed lines on the profile are the passes by the aid station.

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
function gpx(name, coordinates) {
  const points = coordinates.map(([lon, lat]) => `<trkpt lat="${lat}" lon="${lon}"></trkpt>`);
  return `<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<gpx version="1.1" creator="psp-trails" xmlns="http://www.topografix.com/GPX/1/1">
  <trk>
    <name>${name}</name>
    <trkseg>
      ${points.join("\n      ")}
    </trkseg>
  </trk>
</gpx>`;
}

html`<div class="route-actions">
  ${DOM.download(
    () => new Blob([gpx(`Pacific Spirit every trail (${stats.km} km)`, ultra.full)],
                   {type: "application/gpx+xml"}),
    "psp-every-trail.gpx",
    "Download GPX"
  )}
  ${DOM.download(
    () => new Blob([gpx(`Pacific Spirit every trail, no offshoots (${stats.km_without_offshoots} km)`, ultra.main)],
                   {type: "application/gpx+xml"}),
    "psp-every-trail-no-offshoots.gpx",
    "GPX without offshoots"
  )}
</div>`
```

### Where this idea comes from

Running every trail in Pacific Spirit as one ultra isn't our idea: there's an
existing Pacific Spirit Park ultra route that inspired this page. We'll link
it, and its GPX, here. What's on this page is our own version, worked out
from the trail data by code.

### How it's made

Finding the shortest run that covers every trail is a classic puzzle, the
*route inspection* or "Chinese postman" problem. Every junction needs as
many ways in as ways out; where a junction doesn't have that (a dead end, or
three trails meeting), some stretch has to be run twice, or linked up by
road. It's an ultra already, so a bit of road beats running a trail a second
time: the script (`08_plan_ultra.py`) counts a repeat as 2½ times the
distance and road as 1½ times (Imperial Drive and W 29th Ave, which we run
anyway, count the same as trail), picks the cheapest way to join everything
up, and walks it all as one loop from the Park Centre. It only turns
straight back at a dead end; dead-end offshoots of up to 400 m are marked
optional. It uses the same trail data and edits as the
Routes page; see [About](about.qmd).
